symptom: ako/mxcli#2036: CATALOG.SOURCE text for a flow differed from `describe` — it carried @position/layout annotations describe drops as derivable (55 of TestApp's 226 microflows), so scripts generated from the catalog stated layout describe leaves out.
cause: parallelDescribeContext set describeFullLayout: true (#766) to skip useDerivedFlowLayout on cold builds.
insight: The catalog text is read as MDL, not only searched, so it must be byte-identical to describe; the speed trade is paid once on a cold build and the #1790 incremental source build carries unchanged rows. When comparing describe output in Python, read bytes: text-mode subprocess turns CRLF in documentation strings into LF and fakes differences.
